admission_scope: These exact development-only artifacts may be pinned in the new pre-result factor/V2 correction registration. No claim of an exact original-run replay or validated strategy follows from this integrity check.

historical_identity.conclusion: Only the present saved-cache proxy is authenticated by these hashes. Exact original factor-run data bytes and original provider vintages cannot be proven.

snapshot.transformation: Exact original header plus all original CSV lines whose Date is <= 2025-03-31. Original line endings and field text are preserved. No sorting, deduplication, coercion, filling, rounding or value transformation.

validation.fields_checked: Open, High, Low, Close, Volume on retained rows only

limitations: The data remain an unverified current spot/mixed-provider cache proxy; they are not certified perpetual-contract OHLC, original-run input bytes, or contemporaneous provider vintages.

Content hashing authenticates present source and derived bytes only. Mutable cache appends/legacy seeds, absent request receipts, and absent original trial input hashes prevent exact historical provenance reconstruction.

Historical ledger short commit identifiers do not authenticate the whole executed source state: the initial recorded commit precedes the factor script, and later halt-transparency changes were committed after the corresponding records.
No holdout price fields were parsed. Whole-file hashing read bytes for identity; rows after the development cutoff were skipped after inspecting only their Date field.
No strategy signal, position, return, portfolio metric, gate verdict or financial result was computed.

loader_semantics.cache_behavior: Canonical date-independent per-coin CSV; reads with on_bad_lines=skip. Missing canonical file may be seeded from the largest legacy cache. Existing last date >= requested end skips fetching without checking internal gaps or the requested history start. Otherwise daily data are appended and overlapping dates retain the last row.
loader_semantics.cleaning: Legacy _clean_dataframe coerces numeric fields, drops missing Close, forward-fills then backward-fills price/volume fields before applying the end-date filter. Retained source rows contain no invalid or missing numeric fields, so no such fill is needed or performed in these snapshots.
loader_semantics.default_cache_directory: TradingAgents/tradingagents/dataflows/data_cache; default_config derives this from its source path. No application configuration or environment was imported during inspection.
loader_semantics.provider_path: Intended primary Binance spot /api/v3/klines, interval=1d, bitcoin->BTCUSDT and ethereum->ETHUSDT. Initial empty-cache fallback uses CoinGecko USD market-chart prices, with Open/High/Low set equal to Close. No row-level source receipt or market identity is stored.
loader_semantics.time_convention: Binance kline openTime is converted from Unix milliseconds to timezone-naive pandas dates; factor loader strips timezone and normalizes dates. Current CSV dates are midnight and timezone-naive. UTC day-open labeling is inferred from this source path, not independently authenticated by cache metadata. Fetch bounds use local time.mktime.
loader_semantics.warmup: Signals consume all available history through end; only afterwards is the sizing/backtest input sliced to the development window. Sizing volatility warmup remains inside that window in the original caller. All available prior history is preserved, including stateful Donchian history. The 200-day count is a completeness reference only.
